island.title: Mirefen Gardens
island.rule: The gardens repeat one generous six hour dusk shifting gates, rain, wind, and statues, while Echo Roses record six seconds of you to act beside your past self.
island.feel: A wistful rainlit clockwork conservatory where reading a living schedule feels playful instead of hurried.
island.arc: Discover the six hour dusk and sundial skip across Mirefen. Clear the Hourglass Maze and Rain Mausoleum in either order, pull off the one dusk Garden Party heist, earn Moth Wings inside the Drowned Conservatory, relight Great Lamp Four, and face the Last Hour.
moments: Choreographing three rose ghosts of yourself at once across rotating hedges inside the Hourglass Maze.
Fighting your own recorded past against the Gardener Twice and bouncing your old bolts off mirrors.
Chaining Sun, Rain, and Wind in one room to float a mirror, bounce a skylight beam, and blow a spore.
Running the one dusk Garden Party heist and swapping the Golden Clock Key on a balance scale.
Battling the Last Hour backwards in time where your forward bolts cancel her reversed shots mid air.

hourglass_maze.promise: A turning hedge labyrinth where Echo Roses replay six seconds of your footsteps and shots to hold plates, flip clocks, and fire through grates.
hourglass_maze.power: Echo Bud lets you trigger up to three Echo Roses in one room.
hourglass_maze.arc: Learn Echo plate holding and grate shooting, lure the Shear Keeper into thorn cages, pair Echoes with prism mirrors and shadow gates, conduct three Wicks at once, and face the Gardener Twice.
hourglass_maze.boss: The Gardener Twice records your path and bolts to spawn an echo twin. Aim your past shots into mirrors to shatter him.

rain_mausoleum.promise: A flooded stone basilica where spinning the Weather Wheel cycles Sun, Rain, and Wind to drain canals, float buoys, and blow spores across gaps.
rain_mausoleum.power: Vane Rod lets your bolts spin Weather Wheels between Sun, Rain, and Wind.
rain_mausoleum.arc: Learn sheltered flames and sun drained combat, float a mirror buoy into a sunbeam, shatter the Cloud Urn Deacon, ride wind carried spores, chain all three seasons, and silence the Drowned Choir.
rain_mausoleum.boss: The Drowned Choir sings five voices veiled by weather. Spin the wheel mid song to silence each porcelain bust in order.

garden_party.promise: A playful one dusk heist across a six hour estate banquet where every hour unlocks a new trick, from usher stealth to a chandelier raft run.
garden_party.arc: Scout the schedule board freely, then launch at Hour One to fool topiary ushers, slip a rain darkened cellar, ride Hour Four winds across chandeliers, bow trick the Toastmaster, and swap the Golden Clock Key.
garden_party.boss: The Toastmaster guards the Golden Clock Key. Ring the banquet bell or plant an Echo guest to force him to bow open.

conservatory.promise: A flooded glasshouse and lofty rafter canopy built around Moth Wings gliding, thermal updrafts, prism banks, and weather wheels.
conservatory.power: Moth Wings lets you glide smoothly off a dash and refresh flight on updrafts.
conservatory.arc: Open the sunken glass atrium, master Moth Wings in a gentle four stage pavilion, soar over Great Lily Hopper, ride glass roof girders, shatter the canopy seal, and defeat Heron Abbess.
conservatory.boss: Heron Abbess sweeps the dome with gusts and water ripples. Shatter skylights for updrafts and soar above her strikes.

overworld.promise: Explore Mirefen's central dusk lagoon on a six hour loop with handy sundials, Echo Roses, pinnable caves, and paths to three districts.
overworld.aha: Sundials skip or rewind hours with zero waiting, and inner sconces pin shortcuts open forever.
checks: Was reading the six hour dusk sundial clear without feeling rushed?
Did skipping hours at a sundial feel snappy and zero stress?
Were the three beacons, side caves, and district paths inviting to explore?

checks: Did Hour Two noticeably help you coordinate the dual plate trellis?
